text_simplified: Islamic law promises a great reward for whoever treats daughters kindly and patiently provides for and raises them; the Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever cares for two girls until they reach maturity will come on the Day of Resurrection—he and I" and he joined his fingers (Sahih Muslim 2631), and he ﷺ said: "Whoever is tested with anything regarding these daughters, they will be a shield for him from the Fire" (Sahih al-Bukhari 1418). Ibn Battal and Imam al-Nawawi explained that treating them kindly and being patient in their upbringing is a means of accompanying the Prophet ﷺ in Paradise and being saved from the Fire.
